messages:
kevin: quick heads-up: in canary we saw tiny requests (~<=32 tokens) repeatedly requeued during KV warmup spikes. p99 regressed ~35ms. anyone else notice this pattern?

ashley: saw it. when the coalescer hits slot pressure it evicts those smalls aggressively. they then pay KV cold misses repeatedly.

ria: current eviction = slot_pressure -> LRU. no token-weighting or affinity today.

kevin: proposal: lightweight microqueue fastpath + token-weighted eviction. microqueue: tiny requests go into a separate queue assembled every 3ms or on 5 reqs. token-weighted eviction: weight = max(1, tokens/64) to favor tiny ops.

ashley: important: fastpath must kick async prefetch on placement. otherwise we move latency from assembly to kvcache miss.

ria: implementation notes: admission adds `fastpath_ok` boolean in metadata (optional). we can use freeform map for now to avoid proto churn. long-term RFC to add typed AdmissionHint.

kevin: telemetry: batcher.microqueue.hits, batcher.microqueue.evicted, eviction.weighted_ratio, kv.prefetch_hitrate. ops-bot, create a ticket for dashboard panels.

ops-bot: ticket INF-7120 created: panels for microqueue + weighted-evict metrics. ETA 48h. :white_check_mark:

ashley: experiment plan: enable flags on 10 canary hosts, 72h ramp. success if tiny p99 down >=25ms and global token-cost delta <=3%. rollback if kv miss rate +5% or non-tiny latency regresses.

ria: add unit tests for eviction comparator and an integration smoke test for fastpath prefetch invocation.

kevin: I'll open the canary PR with flags `--enable-microqueue-fastpath` and `--enable-token-weight-evict`. thanks — will follow up with RFC draft. :thumbsup:
